title: Add a folder to the Dock with view options
summary: Use dockutil to add a directory to the Dock and choose how it displays (folder icon or stack) and how its contents are viewed (grid, fan, list, or auto).

steps.explain: Adds a directory to the Dock. You can specify the view style (grid, fan, list, auto) and display style (folder, stack).

placeholders.name: DIR_PATH
placeholders.description: Full path to the directory, e.g. /Users/username/Downloads

placeholders.name: VIEW_STYLE
placeholders.description: How the folder contents are displayed: grid, fan, list, or auto

placeholders.name: DISPLAY_STYLE
placeholders.description: How the folder icon looks: folder or stack
